label: The relevant-respect scope bridge from C* for caused movers
description: New non-transcription conditional derivation of the scope bridge b3573a61 (C* for every moved mover). A mover of another that is being moved in some respect has its being caused by another, so C* for caused movers applies to it. Constructive: no case split is needed. Both premises stay OPEN; the second is proposed to follow from the 2026-11-17 esse-composition reasoning, not registered. No premise is established.
